correctness.rationale: First-attainment of global minimum splits every path bijectively into a reversed strictly-positive meander, L0-1 complete strictly-positive return excursions, and terminal meander; level-one visits are preserved by the reversal and marked independently. Catalan first-return e=(1-sqrt(1-z²))/2 and meander q=(1+z+sqrt(1-z²))/(2sqrt(1-z²)), h=q/(1-e), give A=z²v/[4(1-ve)] and C=1+zv[1+zh/2]/[2(1-ve)], hence sum_n z^n E[u^L0 v^L1]=uC²/(1-uA). Coefficient [u v] is z+z²h/2, implying P(L0=L1=1)=2^-(n-1)binom(n-2,floor((n-2)/2)) for all n>=2 and sharp asymptotic (2pi n)^-1/2. Independent exhaustive direct paths n2..10 gave 1/2,1/4,1/4,3/16,... as predicted. Formal decomposition proves all n; enumeration is bounded check.
